entries.en: The manuscript contains alchemic symbols beside drawings of furnaces and glass vessels.
entries.zh: 这份手稿在炉子和玻璃容器的图画旁画有炼金术符号。

entries.en: In the fable, the scholar tries to alchemise lead into gold.
entries.zh: 在这则寓言中，学者试图用炼金术把铅变成金。

entries.en: The historian examined alchemistic notebooks for clues about their owners' experiments.
entries.zh: 历史学家查阅炼金术士的笔记，寻找有关笔记主人实验的线索。

entries.en: The magnet's attractive force pulled the loose pins towards the edge of the tray.
entries.zh: 磁铁的吸引力把散落的大头针拉向托盘边缘。

entries.en: Removing the small fish disrupted the food chain throughout the lake.
entries.zh: 移除小鱼扰乱了整个湖泊的食物链。

entries.en: The students calculated electrical power from their measured voltage and current.
entries.zh: 学生们根据测得的电压和电流计算了电功率。

entries.en: The candidates disagreed about foreign policy during the televised debate.
entries.zh: 候选人在电视辩论中就外交政策产生了分歧。

entries.en: Local fans remember the 1980s as the club's golden age.
entries.zh: 当地球迷将二十世纪八十年代视为俱乐部的黄金时代。

entries.en: The pilot practised moving her arms while wearing the bulky pressure suit.
entries.zh: 飞行员穿着笨重的增压服练习移动手臂。

entries.en: A water rat slipped from the bank into the reeds beside our boat.
entries.zh: 一只河鼠从岸边钻进了我们船旁的芦苇丛。

entries.en: The exhibition contrasted alchemistical portraits with pictures of later laboratory scientists.
entries.zh: 展览将炼金术士的肖像与后来实验室科学家的画像作了对比。

entries.en: The play's magician promises to alchemize a copper coin before the sceptical crowd.
entries.zh: 剧中的魔术师向持怀疑态度的人群承诺，用炼金术改变一枚铜币。

entries.en: The survey distinguished alcohol-dependent participants from people who reported occasional drinking.
entries.zh: 这项调查将酒精依赖的参与者与自述偶尔饮酒的人区分开来。

entries.en: The instructor brought a cutaway four-stroke engine to the mechanics class.
entries.zh: 教练把一台剖开的四冲程发动机带到了机械课上。

entries.en: The painter chose bright blue for the cloudless sky above the harbour.
entries.zh: 画家选择了鲜亮的蓝色来画港口上方无云的天空。

entries.en: The pharmaceutical company opened a new facility for manufacturing injectable medicines.
entries.zh: 这家制药公司开设了一家生产注射药物的新工厂。

entries.en: Two heavy soup pots occupied most of the kitchen range.
entries.zh: 两口沉重的汤锅占据了炉灶的大部分位置。

entries.en: Fat chance of front-row seats now; the queue already stretches around the block.
entries.zh: 现在还想坐前排，哪有希望；队伍已经绕着街区排开了。

entries.en: The gallery held a cocktail party before opening its new exhibition.
entries.zh: 画廊在新展览开幕前举办了一场鸡尾酒会。

entries.en: From the control tower, staff watched the small aircraft taxi towards the runway.
entries.zh: 工作人员从指挥塔台观看小型飞机滑向跑道。

entries.en: The label identified the dye as alcohol-soluble rather than water-soluble.
entries.zh: 标签注明这种染料可溶于酒精，而非溶于水。

entries.en: The laboratory protocol required staff to alcoholize the botanical material before analysis.
entries.zh: 实验室规程要求工作人员在分析前用酒精处理植物材料。

entries.en: The experiment recorded changes in each participant's cognitive state after a sleepless night.
entries.zh: 实验记录了每位参与者彻夜未眠后的认知状态变化。

entries.en: The captain grew tired of the sea lawyer questioning every order on deck.
entries.zh: 那个好争辩的水手质疑甲板上的每一道命令，使船长厌烦了。

entries.en: She slowed the music so the beginners could practise the difficult dance step.
entries.zh: 她放慢了音乐，让初学者练习那个困难的舞步。

entries.en: The small firm sells one software product for managing theatre bookings.
entries.zh: 这家小公司销售一款管理剧院订票的软件产品。

entries.en: The seminar compared two court opinions that reached different conclusions about fair use.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了两份对合理使用得出不同结论的法院意见。

entries.en: The children watched the full moon rise behind the dark hills.
entries.zh: 孩子们看着满月从黑暗的山丘后升起。

entries.en: The chemist identified an aldehydic component in the sample's chemical profile.
entries.zh: 化学家在样本的化学组成中识别出了一种醛类成分。

entries.en: The newspaper compared aldermanic voting records before the municipal election.
entries.zh: 报纸在市政选举前比较了市议员们的投票记录。

entries.en: The outreach report included an interview with a former drug user.
entries.zh: 这份外展服务报告收录了对一位前吸毒者的访谈。

entries.en: The treasurer transferred part of this year's surplus into the reserve account.
entries.zh: 财务主管将今年的部分盈余转入了准备金账户。

entries.en: On free afternoons, they would jazz around the harbour looking for entertainment.
entries.zh: 空闲的下午，他们会在港口四处闲逛，寻找乐子。

entries.en: The television station interrupted its programme to announce the storm warning.
entries.zh: 电视台中断节目，播报了暴风雨预警。

entries.en: The server passed a stress test involving thousands of simultaneous logins.
entries.zh: 这台服务器通过了涉及数千次同时登录的负荷试验。

entries.en: The food historian found an advertisement for process cheese in the old magazine.
entries.zh: 食品史学家在旧杂志中找到了一则加工混合干酪的广告。

entries.en: She set the boiled egg upright in a blue ceramic egg cup.
entries.zh: 她把煮熟的鸡蛋直立放在一个蓝色陶瓷蛋杯里。

entries.en: The medical review grouped the aldosteronism cases by their recorded underlying causes.
entries.zh: 这篇医学综述按记录的潜在病因将醛固酮增多症病例分组。

entries.en: The small boat drifted alee while the crew adjusted its sail.
entries.zh: 船员调整船帆时，小船向下风方向漂去。

entries.en: The museum displayed a glass alembic beside an early chemist's notebook.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一位早期化学家的笔记旁展出了一套玻璃蒸馏器。

entries.en: The bowl was paper thin at the rim, so we packed it carefully.
entries.zh: 这只碗的口沿薄如纸，所以我们小心地把它包好。

entries.en: The child mistook the plus sign for a multiplication symbol.
entries.zh: 孩子把加号误认成了乘号。

entries.en: Faster unloading reduced the cargo ship's turnaround time in port.
entries.zh: 更快的卸货速度缩短了这艘货船在港口的周转时间。

entries.en: Our direct flight stopped briefly on the island, but we stayed on the same aircraft.
entries.zh: 我们的直航航班在岛上短暂停留，但我们仍乘坐同一架飞机。

entries.en: His eyes began to glaze over halfway through the lengthy technical briefing.
entries.zh: 冗长的技术简报进行到一半时，他的目光开始变得呆滞。

entries.en: The rescuers set free the owl after its damaged wing had healed.
entries.zh: 猫头鹰受伤的翅膀痊愈后，救援人员将它放生了。

entries.en: Her employer contributed to the pension plan every month she worked there.
entries.zh: 她在那儿工作的每个月，雇主都会向养老金计划缴款。

entries.en: The lecturer wrote aleph-null beside the set of natural numbers on the board.
entries.zh: 讲师在黑板上自然数集的旁边写下了阿列夫零。

entries.en: Her notes used aleph-zero throughout the discussion of countably infinite sets.
entries.zh: 她的笔记在讨论可数无限集时始终使用阿列夫零。

entries.en: The researcher photographed the aleuronic layer around the grain's endosperm.
entries.zh: 研究人员拍摄了谷粒胚乳周围的糊粉层。

entries.en: In the novel, a servant girl overhears the conversation outside the dining room.
entries.zh: 小说中，一个女仆在餐厅外无意中听到了那段谈话。

entries.en: The judgment examined whether the shopkeeper had exercised ordinary care before opening.
entries.zh: 判决考察了店主在开门营业前是否尽到了一般注意义务。

entries.en: She decorated the dark biscuits with thin curls of white chocolate.
entries.zh: 她用薄薄的白巧克力卷装饰了深色饼干。

entries.en: The waiter brought a sealed bottle of mineral water to the table.
entries.zh: 服务员给餐桌送来了一瓶未开封的矿泉水。

entries.en: The senior high organised a science fair for students from nearby schools.
entries.zh: 这所高中为附近学校的学生举办了科学展览。

entries.en: At dawn, traders rolled their carts into the market place beside the fountain.
entries.zh: 黎明时，商贩们把手推车推到喷泉旁的市场。

entries.en: The assessment described alexia despite the patient's otherwise fluent spoken language.
entries.zh: 评估报告描述了患者的失读症，尽管患者的口语在其他方面仍很流利。

entries.en: The alexic patient could describe the drawing but could not read its caption.
entries.zh: 这位失读症患者能描述图画，却读不出图注。

entries.en: We ate alfresco beneath the vines while the evening was still warm.
entries.zh: 傍晚尚且暖和时，我们在葡萄藤下露天吃饭。

entries.en: The translator checked whether the joke sounded natural in the target language.
entries.zh: 译者检查了这个笑话在目标语言中听起来是否自然。

entries.en: The financial analyst compared the company's profit margins with those of its rivals.
entries.zh: 财务分析师将这家公司的利润率与竞争对手进行了比较。

entries.en: The receipts left a paper trail linking the purchases to the missing funds.
entries.zh: 这些收据留下了书面线索，将那些购买行为与失踪资金联系起来。

entries.en: The buyer sought specific performance after the seller refused to transfer the house.
entries.zh: 卖方拒绝转让房屋后，买方请求判令实际履行合同。

entries.en: The technician converted every heat unit in the old table into joules.
entries.zh: 技术员将旧表中的每个热量单位都换算成了焦耳。

entries.en: The student found an algebraical solution after abandoning the complicated diagram.
entries.zh: 学生放弃复杂的图解后，找到了一种代数解法。

entries.en: The algebraist spent her sabbatical studying representations of finite groups.
entries.zh: 这位代数学家利用学术休假研究有限群的表示。

entries.en: An algid wind swept through the stone courtyard before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，一阵寒风扫过石砌庭院。

entries.en: The first interview helped us winnow out applicants without the required experience.
entries.zh: 第一轮面试帮助我们筛掉了不具备所需经验的申请人。

entries.en: The catalogue identified the antique shotgun's mechanism as slide action.
entries.zh: 目录将这支古董霰弹枪的机构标为前托推拉式。

entries.en: In all probability, the missing parcel is still at the sorting office.
entries.zh: 很可能，丢失的包裹还在邮件分拣处。

entries.en: The swimming pool closed its shower room while workers repaired the tiles.
entries.zh: 工人维修瓷砖期间，游泳池关闭了淋浴室。

entries.en: The comic's offer of hair of the dog drew a groan from his hungover friend.
entries.zh: 喜剧演员提出喝点“解醉酒”，让宿醉的朋友呻吟了一声。

entries.en: The town's market cross appears in paintings made two centuries apart.
entries.zh: 相隔两个世纪创作的画作中都出现了这座镇上的市场十字架。

entries.en: An algoid green film covered the stones beneath the dripping pipe.
entries.zh: 滴水管下的石头覆着一层水藻般的绿色薄膜。

entries.en: The psychology essay discussed algolagnia in a character who derived sexual pleasure from personally experiencing physical pain.
entries.zh: 这篇心理学论文讨论了一个从亲身经历身体疼痛中获得性愉悦的人物的受虐倾向。

entries.en: The poor fish bought another fake ticket from the same dishonest seller.
entries.zh: 那个又蠢又可怜的家伙又从同一个不诚实的卖家手里买了一张假票。

entries.en: After an hour of searching, we had found bugger all.
entries.zh: 找了一个小时后，我们还是什么都没找到。

entries.en: The stage set changed from a railway platform to a crowded kitchen.
entries.zh: 舞台布景从火车站月台变成了拥挤的厨房。

entries.en: The executive agency submitted its annual spending report to the legislature.
entries.zh: 这个行政执行机构向立法机构提交了年度支出报告。

entries.en: The sports club cancelled target practice while the range underwent repairs.
entries.zh: 靶场维修期间，体育俱乐部取消了射击练习。

entries.en: The appeal board reviewed the rejected applications at its monthly meeting.
entries.zh: 上诉委员会在月度会议上复核了被拒绝的申请。

entries.en: The restaurant bought sacks of rice from a wholesale house near the docks.
entries.zh: 餐馆从码头附近的一家批发商行购买了成袋的大米。

entries.en: Her research in algology took her to freshwater lakes across the region.
entries.zh: 她的藻类学研究使她走访了该地区各处的淡水湖。

entries.en: The researcher recorded the algometer's calibration date in the equipment log.
entries.zh: 研究人员在设备日志中记录了痛觉测量仪的校准日期。

entries.en: A tag end of ribbon clung to the seam after she trimmed the costume.
entries.zh: 她修剪完戏服后，一小截缎带末端仍粘在接缝上。

entries.en: The narrator calls him a stupid person, although his decisions later prove sensible.
entries.zh: 叙述者称他为笨汉，尽管他的决定后来证明是明智的。

entries.en: The carpenter carved two intertwined branches into the headboard of the marriage bed.
entries.zh: 木匠在婚床的床头板上雕刻了两根相互缠绕的树枝。

entries.en: The economist used the theory of games to analyse competing firms' pricing choices.
entries.zh: 经济学家运用博弈论分析相互竞争的公司的定价选择。

entries.en: The exhibition described how microscopy helped challenge the discredited theory of preformation.
entries.zh: 展览介绍了显微观察如何帮助挑战已经被否定的预成论。

entries.en: The stunt woman rehearsed the rooftop jump before the cameras began rolling.
entries.zh: 开机拍摄前，女替身演员排练了屋顶跳跃动作。

entries.en: The novel contrasts the upper class with the servants maintaining its grand houses.
entries.zh: 小说将上层社会与维持其豪宅运转的仆人作了对比。

entries.en: The laboratory archived the algometric readings with the instrument's calibration records.
entries.zh: 实验室将痛觉测量读数与仪器的校准记录一并归档。

entries.en: An equipment fault made the first set of algometrical measurements unreliable.
entries.zh: 设备故障使第一组痛觉测量数据不可靠。

entries.en: The archive preserved the contract under seal alongside the original land survey.
entries.zh: 档案馆将这份签字蜡封合同与原始土地测量图一起保存。

entries.en: The conservator repaired the point lace on the wedding gown with fine thread.
entries.zh: 修复师用细线修补了婚纱上的针绣花边。

entries.en: The residents promised to raise hell if the council ignored the sewage leak again.
entries.zh: 居民们表示，如果市政委员会再次无视污水泄漏，他们就要大闹抗议。

entries.en: The military historian compared accounts of close support during the battle.
entries.zh: 军事史学家比较了有关这场战斗中近距火力支援的记述。

entries.en: The gallery will allow visitors in once the installation is complete.
entries.zh: 装置作品安装完毕后，画廊将准许访客入内。

entries.en: Our cottage is a stone's throw from the village bakery.
entries.zh: 我们的小屋离村里的面包店只有很短的一段路。

entries.en: The restaurant's powder room was at the end of the upstairs corridor.
entries.zh: 餐馆的女卫生间在楼上走廊的尽头。

entries.en: The academic review discussed algophilia without including graphic descriptions of sexual behaviour.
entries.zh: 这篇学术综述讨论了嗜痛癖，没有包含对性行为的露骨描述。

entries.en: The interview explored how algophobia affected her willingness to join ordinary activities.
entries.zh: 访谈探讨了疼痛恐惧症如何影响她参加日常活动的意愿。

entries.en: Please read the full complaint before you go off half-cocked and accuse someone.
entries.zh: 请先读完全部投诉内容，再考虑反应，别急着指责任何人。

entries.en: Her married older sister served as matron of honor at the wedding.
entries.zh: 她已婚的姐姐在婚礼上担任首席女傧相。

entries.en: Our first estimate was wide of the mark, so we collected more measurements.
entries.zh: 我们最初的估计偏离实际很远，因此又收集了更多测量数据。

entries.en: The report tried to gloss over the accounting errors with vague language.
entries.zh: 报告试图用含糊的措辞掩盖会计错误。

entries.en: Water from the millpond supplied the motive power for the grinding machinery.
entries.zh: 磨坊池塘里的水为研磨机械提供了动力。

entries.en: She placed the teapot and three cups on the small tea table.
entries.zh: 她把茶壶和三个茶杯放在小茶几上。

entries.en: The history lesson contrasted algorism with older methods using Roman numerals.
entries.zh: 历史课将阿拉伯数字计数法与使用罗马数字的旧方法进行了比较。

entries.en: The surveyor aligned the alidad with the distant church spire.
entries.zh: 测量员将照准仪对准了远处的教堂尖顶。

entries.en: The student checked the alidade before drawing another sight line on the map.
entries.zh: 学生在地图上画下一条视线前检查了照准仪。

entries.en: The district manager reviewed sales figures from all twelve branches.
entries.zh: 地区经理审查了全部十二家分店的销售数据。

entries.en: The historian questioned whether the puppet government controlled any important decisions independently.
entries.zh: 历史学家质疑这个傀儡政府是否曾独立掌控任何重要决策。

entries.en: The hotel bill included breakfast but charged extra for parking.
entries.zh: 旅馆账单包含早餐费，但另收停车费。

entries.en: We used three-way calling to bring the supplier into our telephone discussion.
entries.zh: 我们利用三方通话，让供应商加入了我们的电话讨论。

entries.en: They managed to eke out a living by repairing fishing nets.
entries.zh: 他们靠修补渔网勉强维持生计。

entries.en: The catalogue classified the old pistol as a light arm.
entries.zh: 目录将这支旧手枪归为轻兵器。

entries.en: The legal historian examined how alienage affected the merchant's property rights.
entries.zh: 法律史学家研究了外国人身份如何影响这位商人的财产权。

entries.en: The deed named the buyer as alienee of the transferred property.
entries.zh: 契据将买方列为所转让财产的受让人。

entries.en: The board of directors postponed the vote until the audit was complete.
entries.zh: 董事会将投票推迟到审计完成之后。

entries.en: The board of regents reviewed the university's policies on student accommodation.
entries.zh: 大学董事会审查了学校关于学生住宿的政策。

entries.en: The school's board of trustees approved funding for a new library.
entries.zh: 学校的受托管理委员会批准了新图书馆的经费。

entries.en: Investigators hoped to winkle out the corrupt officials hiding behind procedural delays.
entries.zh: 调查人员希望揪出那些躲在程序拖延背后的腐败官员。

entries.en: The festival invited village elders to perform ethnic music from their own communities.
entries.zh: 音乐节邀请村中长者表演各自社群的民族音乐。

entries.en: Her son's son brought his boy, her great grandson, to help scan the family photographs.
entries.zh: 她儿子的儿子带着自己的儿子，也就是她的曾孙，来帮忙扫描家族照片。

entries.en: The old-age pensioner volunteered at the museum two afternoons a week.
entries.zh: 这位领取养老金的老人每周有两个下午在博物馆做志愿者。

entries.en: The library shelved the nineteenth-century volume on alienism among historical medical texts.
entries.zh: 图书馆将这部十九世纪的精神病学著作归入历史医学文献。

entries.en: The solicitor checked that the alienor had signed the transfer document.
entries.zh: 律师核实了财产让渡人已经在转让文件上签字。

entries.en: The fossil's aliform projections were visible on both sides of the specimen.
entries.zh: 标本两侧都能看见这块化石上的翼状突起。

entries.en: We promised to give our best even if the opposing team looked stronger.
entries.zh: 即使对手看起来更强，我们也承诺会竭尽全力。

entries.en: The union delegate cast a block vote representing all its registered members.
entries.zh: 工会代表投出了代表所有登记会员的集团票。

entries.en: The geometry software displayed the plane section as the cutting surface moved.
entries.zh: 随着切割平面移动，几何软件显示出相应的剖面。

entries.en: Small alpine flowers grew between the stones in the rock garden.
entries.zh: 小小的高山花卉生长在岩石园的石头缝间。

entries.en: The drainage system overflowed after leaves blocked the channels beside the road.
entries.zh: 树叶堵住路旁沟渠后，排水系统发生了溢流。

entries.en: The target range closed early because of damage to its perimeter fence.
entries.zh: 靶场因外围围栏损坏而提前关闭。

entries.en: The survey team set the plane table on level ground near the stream.
entries.zh: 测量队将平板仪架在了小溪附近的平地上。

entries.en: In the old account, villagers carried aliment to families stranded by the snow.
entries.zh: 这份旧记述中，村民们把食物送给被大雪困住的家庭。

entries.en: The physician's historical notes praised the alimental value of the broth.
entries.zh: 这位医生留下的历史笔记称赞了这道汤的营养价值。

entries.en: The messenger reached general headquarters after travelling through the night.
entries.zh: 信使连夜赶路后抵达了总司令部。

entries.en: The students measured the coil's coefficient of self induction in the circuit laboratory.
entries.zh: 学生们在电路实验室测量了线圈的自感系数。

entries.en: The camera's film advance jammed halfway through the roll.
entries.zh: 这台相机的胶片传送机构在胶卷用到一半时卡住了。

entries.en: The captain and crew signed the articles of agreement before the ship sailed.
entries.zh: 船长和船员在启航前签署了雇佣协议。

entries.en: The mill had long since closed when the photographer arrived.
entries.zh: 摄影师到来时，磨坊早已关闭了。

entries.en: The loud machinery may frighten off birds nesting near the work site.
entries.zh: 吵闹的机械可能吓走在工地附近筑巢的鸟。

entries.en: A missing single quote caused the short program to fail.
entries.zh: 漏掉一个单引号使这段小程序运行失败。

entries.en: The relief committee organised the alimentation of families isolated by the flood.
entries.zh: 救济委员会组织为被洪水隔绝的家庭供应食物。

entries.en: The article compared the alimentative roles of different foods in the traditional diet.
entries.zh: 文章比较了传统饮食中不同食物提供营养的作用。

entries.en: Her careful choice of words kept the disagreement from becoming personal.
entries.zh: 她谨慎的用语使分歧没有演变成人身冲突。

entries.en: The museum's space travel exhibit included letters written by early astronauts.
entries.zh: 博物馆的太空旅行展览包括早期宇航员写的信件。

entries.en: The young pianist became the city's golden boy after winning an international prize.
entries.zh: 这位年轻钢琴家获得国际大奖后，成了全市瞩目的成功青年。

entries.en: She added a dollar mark before each amount in the budget table.
entries.zh: 她在预算表中的每个金额前加上了美元符号。

entries.en: By withholding the key documents, the manager was in effect blocking the investigation.
entries.zh: 经理扣住关键文件，实际上是在阻挠调查。

entries.en: We ate fish and chips on a bench overlooking the harbour.
entries.zh: 我们坐在俯瞰港口的长凳上吃炸鱼薯条。

entries.en: His slow manner of speaking made even ordinary announcements sound solemn.
entries.zh: 他缓慢的说话方式使普通通知听起来也很庄重。

entries.en: The chemistry exercise asked students to distinguish aliphatic compounds from aromatic ones.
entries.zh: 这道化学练习要求学生区分脂肪族化合物和芳香族化合物。

entries.en: She marked six as an aliquant of twenty on her worksheet.
entries.zh: 她在练习纸上把六标为不能整除二十的数。

entries.en: He called himself an aliterate, despite reading fluently whenever work required it.
entries.zh: 他自称不爱读书的人，尽管工作需要时他能流利阅读。

entries.en: The essay examined how censorship restricted political liberty during the emergency.
entries.zh: 这篇文章考察了紧急状态期间审查制度如何限制政治自由。

entries.en: Her research in marine law focused on disputes over international fishing grounds.
entries.zh: 她的海上法研究重点关注国际渔场争端。

entries.en: The diagram traced the chromosomes from each sex cell into the fertilised egg.
entries.zh: 图中追踪了染色体从各个生殖细胞进入受精卵的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 在城市有巧妙生存能力的
entries.en: Her street smart cousin quickly spotted the tourist scam outside the station.
entries.zh: 她那位熟悉都市生存之道的表亲很快识破了车站外针对游客的骗局。

entries.en: The packing list separated solid food from drinks and liquid ingredients.
entries.zh: 装箱清单将固体食物与饮料和液体原料分开列出。

entries.en: The experiment measured how a radio wave weakened after passing through the wall.
entries.zh: 实验测量了无线电波穿过墙壁后的衰减程度。

entries.en: A recorded thunderclap supplied the sound effect for the storm scene.
entries.zh: 一段录制的雷声为暴风雨场景提供了音响效果。

entries.en: The chart recorded alkalemia alongside the laboratory's blood pH measurements.
entries.zh: 病历图表在实验室血液酸碱度测量值旁记录了碱血症。

entries.en: The sample remained alkalescent throughout the afternoon's series of measurements.
entries.zh: 在整个下午的一系列测量中，样本始终呈微碱性。

entries.en: She requested a wake-up call for six before checking into the hotel.
entries.zh: 她在入住酒店前要求六点提供叫醒电话。

entries.en: The grocer moved the breakfast food beside the milk and yoghurt display.
entries.zh: 杂货商将早餐谷类食品移到了牛奶和酸奶陈列区旁。

entries.en: The final cup tie drew supporters from every village in the valley.
entries.zh: 这场杯赛决赛吸引了山谷里各村的支持者。

entries.en: The harbour museum displayed a model of a nineteenth-century war vessel.
entries.zh: 港口博物馆展出了一艘十九世纪军舰的模型。

entries.en: Moss filled the gaps in the dry-stone wall around the sheep pasture.
entries.zh: 羊牧场周围的干砌石墙缝隙里长满了苔藓。

entries.en: The accountant noticed a missing signature on the final tax form.
entries.zh: 会计发现最后一张纳税表上少了签名。

entries.en: A fellow worker offered to cover her shift during the family emergency.
entries.zh: 一位同事提出在她家中发生紧急情况时替她值班。

entries.en: The geologist compared the alkalic rocks with samples from the neighbouring ridge.
entries.zh: 地质学家将这些碱性岩石与邻近山脊的样本进行了比较。

entries.en: The students observed how the added reagent could alkalify the acidic solution.
entries.zh: 学生们观察了加入的试剂如何使酸性溶液变成碱性。

entries.en: The chemistry class used alkalimetry to compare the acidity of two unknown samples.
entries.zh: 化学课上，学生用碱量滴定法比较了两个未知样本的酸度。

entries.en: The hospital archive contained a separate register of admissions involving heart failure.
entries.zh: 医院档案中单独保存了一本心力衰竭相关入院病例登记册。

entries.en: Her portfolio included a blue-chip stock that had paid dividends for decades.
entries.zh: 她的投资组合中包含一只已连续数十年支付股息的蓝筹股。

entries.en: The museum consulted a blind person when designing its tactile exhibition labels.
entries.zh: 博物馆在设计触摸式展品标签时征求了一位盲人的意见。

entries.en: The forecast showed a warm front approaching the coast from the southwest.
entries.zh: 天气预报显示，一道暖锋正从西南方向接近海岸。

entries.en: A small bottle of scented toilet water stood on her mother's dressing table.
entries.zh: 她母亲的梳妆台上放着一小瓶有香味的花露水。

entries.en: The pianist circled the single sixty-fourth note she kept missing in practice.
entries.zh: 钢琴家圈出了练习中总是漏掉的那个六十四分音符。

entries.en: The coach adapted each exercise to the participant's physical ability.
entries.zh: 教练根据参与者的身体能力调整了每项练习。
